reason: I already go out most weeks and I am sick of finding out about things two days late on someone's story. If it is actually all in one place with real dates, I will use it, and I would buy one concert ticket through it if the price really is the same 700 Lek.
objection: Everything is already on Instagram, and every app that promised 'all the events in one place' before was half empty after a month. If I open it and the thing my friend posted on her story is not there, I am done with it.
would_change_my_mind: Nothing to flip, since I would try it. What would keep me is seeing it beat Instagram twice in the first two weeks, showing me an event before I saw it anywhere else.
